messages:
mike: hey team quick question — opened a tiny PR to fix sampleapp shebang and binstub so `./bin/run_sample` works on mac/linux/windows wsl. CI passes everywhere except an odd bundler error on ruby-3.0 job. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1518

ruth: what's the bundler error? is it complaining about binstubs or a mismatched lockfile?

mike: error snippet: `Could not find 'thor' (>= 0) among 200 total gem(s)` even though bundle install succeeded earlier in the workflow. Happens only in the ruby-3.0 matrix job.

ci-bot: workflow ruby-ci matrix started. failing job: ruby-3.0 (binstub resolution). logs: https://ci.internal/builds/11023

jason: that usually means the PATH used to run the test isn't using `bundle exec` and the binstub wasn't generated. In our scripts we sometimes call `./bin/run_sample` directly; CI runner might not have `bin` in exec path. Two quick suggestions: 1) ensure `bundle binstubs --all` runs in setup, or 2) wrap invocation with `bundle exec` in CI.

mike: good call. I intentionally changed the script to be runnable without `bundle exec` for dev convenience but didn't update CI. I'll update the GH action to run `bundle exec ./bin/run_sample --help` in the smoke job.

ruth: also add a guard in the script: exit with a helpful message if required gems missing, e.g. `unless defined?(Redwood); puts "run 'bundle install'"; exit 1 end`. saves folks from confusing PATH issues.

mike: will add guard + update CI. one more community ask: someone reported on Windows PowerShell the shebang line `#!/usr/bin/env ruby` got ignored and the script tried to run with `sh`. any tips to add to README?

jason: add a README note: on Windows use `ruby bin/run_sample` or run under WSL. For PowerShell add a `.bat` shim or use `ruby -S bin/run_sample`. Also mention `bundle exec` to pick up correct gems.

ci-bot: mike pushed commit 6a2b1f. CI re-run: ruby-3.0 job retriggered.

mike: updated script to check for missing gems and added `ruby -S` example to README. I also added `bundle exec` to the CI smoke test.

ruth: tiny nit for PR: prefer `abort("message")` instead of `puts; exit 1` in scripts. keeps output consistent.

mike: updated to `abort` and pushed. thanks.

ci-bot: all matrix jobs now green. build: https://ci.internal/builds/11028

mike: great — merging. I'll open a short community note showing how to run sampleapp on Windows + WSL + PowerShell and link to the README changes. cc @community-bot for tracking.

community-bot: created issue community/docs#123 "Sampleapp: running on Windows and common gotchas" and linked PR 1518.

jason: thanks for the tidy PR. this should reduce onboarding friction for new contributors. :raised_hands:

mike: thanks all. closing loop here — will follow up on the community post.
